description: This file defines interfaces for an IPC server and client within the Rialto project, including classes IClient and IServer, with methods for managing client connections, sending messages, and server processing.

classes.name: IClient
classes.description: Interface representing a connected client, providing methods to query client info, send events, and manage connection.

classes.name: IServer
classes.description: Interface representing the IPC server, providing methods to add sockets, create clients, and process I/O events.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Creates a listening socket for incoming client connections, optionally with callbacks for connection events.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Creates a new client object from a socket file descriptor, with optional disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns an external event loop file descriptor for the server.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or timeout, blocking until events occur or timeout expires.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles incoming connections and data, processing I/O events.
